Position: Vue.js Developer

Position Summary
We are Aurora Digital Labs, a growing enterprise software company building next-generation customer engagement platforms for large retail and financial services customers. We are seeking a motivated Vue.js Developer to join our front-end engineering team in Delhi NCR. The successful candidate will work on building responsive, high-performance single-page applications that integrate with backend services and analytics platforms. This is an on-site role requiring presence in the Delhi NCR office five days a week. The role suits an engineer with at least 1+ years of commercial experience focused on Vue.js and JavaScript who wants to grow in a product-oriented, collaborative engineering environment.

Key Responsibilities

Product Development and Feature Delivery
- Implement new features and user interfaces for Aurora's customer engagement web applications using Vue.js and JavaScript.
- Translate UX designs and product requirements into well-structured components, pages, and reusable UI patterns.
- Collaborate with product managers and designers to refine requirements, estimate work, and deliver high-quality increments on a regular cadence.

Component Design and Code Quality
- Design and implement component-based architectures, ensuring modularity, reusability, and maintainability.
- Write unit and integration tests for front-end components; participate in code reviews and drive improvements based on feedback.
- Enforce front-end best practices for accessibility, responsiveness, performance, and cross-browser compatibility.

Integration and Collaboration
- Integrate front-end components with RESTful and GraphQL APIs, handle client-side state, and manage asynchronous data flows.
- Work closely with backend engineers, QA, and DevOps to enable continuous delivery and efficient troubleshooting of production issues.
- Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and technical discussions to evolve the product and development processes.

Performance, Monitoring, and Optimization
- Identify and mitigate front-end performance bottlenecks; implement lazy loading, code-splitting, and other optimizations as appropriate.
- Monitor client-side errors and performance metrics; contribute to incident response and root-cause analysis when issues arise.
- Maintain and evolve front-end build and bundling processes to support rapid iteration and reliable releases.

Required Qualifications

Experience
- 1+ years of hands-on professional experience building web applications.

Technical Skills (Required / Mandatory)
- Vue.js
- JavaScript

Preferred Qualifications (Good-to-have)
- Familiarity with Vite
- Experience with TypeScript
- Strong CSS skills for responsive, accessible UI implementation
- Experience with Nuxt.js for server-side rendering or static-site generation

Success Metrics
- Timely delivery of assigned features with an average adherence to sprint estimates above 80%.
- Component test coverage and automated front-end tests meet team targets (as measured by CI reports) within 3 months.
- Reduction in front-end performance regressions: maintain or improve client-side performance scores (e.g., Lighthouse) for owned pages.
- Number of production incidents related to front-end ownership reduced through proactive monitoring and timely fixes.
- Demonstrated growth in ownership: independently deliver end-to-end features from design to production within the first 6 months.

Location and Work Mode
- Delhi NCR, on-site 5 days a week. No remote option.
